en.text:
Grants 20% Damage Resistance while overcharging a <void/>Void Grenade with <void/>Chaos Accelerant.

Overcharged Grenade Hits apply <void/>Weaken for 6 seconds and grant additional base grenade Regeneration Rate depending on the equipped grenade for 1.75 seconds.

• Axion: <pve 5000% /> <pvp [4000%] /> 
• Scatter: <pve 3700% /> <pvp [2700%] />
• Vortex: <pve 3400% /> <pvp [2400%] />
• Handheld Supernova: <pve 2500% /> <pvp [2000%] />

4 second cooldown between activations, which is removed on grenade usage. Grants between 50-60% Grenade energy per activation.

<void/>Vortex Grenades can proc twice if enemies get hit by the initial explosion and the last few ticks.
